reason: Adds a DSH Web approval-card option to authorize matching danger-full-access requests for the current task turn, reducing repeated prompts while preserving per-task scope.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH Web 审批卡片增加“允许本次任务”选项，在当前任务内授权同类高权限请求并在任务结束后失效。
summaries.en: Adds an “Allow for this task” option to DSH Web approval cards, authorizing matching high-privilege requests for the current task turn.

capabilities: Adds a task-scoped approval option for danger-full-access requests
Automatically approves matching high-privilege requests within the current turn after user authorization
Integrates with the host authorization endpoint and modifies the DSH Web approval card
